attributes.title: APTA CSM 2027 Philadelphia
attributes.summary: APTA holds the 2027 Combined Sections Meeting February 4 to 6 at the Pennsylvania Convention Center in Philadelphia. In-person attendance can earn up to 1.35 CEUs (13.5 contact hours), plus up to 0.45 CEUs from three CSM On Demand sessions; full in-person registration includes On Demand access. Advance rates run to January 6, 2027: $615 for a PT section member, $855 for a non-member and $335 for a student, with higher full and on-site rates from January 7. PTA, life member and speaker rates are listed separately.
